_source: Option tables of the par-03 user choices. Alternatives are step-2 findings (JLC database and DigiKey queried 2026-11-21, datasheets under datasheets/files/) that parts/out/ does not hold, because it lists only the schematic's current part per line. A cell may contain {REF.field}: analysis/01_parts/figures.py replaces it with that column of the parts/out/availability.csv line holding REF, so the schematic's own part follows a parts/bom.py rerun. Every user-choice ref of parts/decisions.csv must be in some choice's refs (figures.py fails otherwise).

fpga.title: Choice 1: FPGA U30, XC7A35T or XC7A100T
rows: JLC assembles; value C to I (par-04)
about a third of the logic
fpga.consequence: Pin check done: all 256 U30 pins exist on the 35T with the same name, bank and I/O type (AMD package files), so a swap needs no re-route. 35T: cheaper part, 35T bitstream, less logic. 100T: schematic kept, about USD 26 more per board at JLC.
fpga.recommendation: B (100T, I grade, JLC) if the headroom is wanted, else D; I rather than C for the -40 C start and because JLC stocks the 100T only as I.

adc.title: Choice 2: ADC U8, LTC2292 C or I grade
rows: no I-grade row; C grade C46629037 stock 0
adc.consequence: Either way U8 is consigned from DigiKey. I grade costs USD 7.91 more per part (23.73 for 3). Same QFN-64 package and pinout. The LTC2292 order table is not on file (the file is the LTC2294 sheet), so the codes come from the distributor rows.
adc.recommendation: B, the I grade: matches the -40 to 85 C of the other RF parts, stock 334, 13 week lead.

usbc.title: Choice 3: USB-C receptacle J1 (GCT_USB4105 footprint)
usbc.consequence: A to C share the footprint family. The GCT performance spec is on file (gct-usb4105-datasheet, Rev A3: -40 to 85 C, 5 A on VBUS, p.2) but does not define the -060 and -120 suffixes or the contact count. For the user to obtain: the GCT USB4105 mechanical drawing (gct.co product page), to confirm the variants fit the board edge and match the 16-contact footprint.
usbc.recommendation: A (base code, most stock at both sources) once you have saved the GCT datasheet and confirmed the variants.

inductor.title: Choice 4: inductor L5-L7 (SRR6040A-330M, 33 uH)
rows: about 1.0 A against 3.5 A typ (5.1 A max)
1.20 A Isat: still below 3.5 A; footprint change
0.97 A rated: still below 3.5 A; footprint change
inductor.consequence: Datasheet p.18: Isat must exceed the peak current limit (p.5: 3.5 A typ, 5.1 A max). The SRR6040A's listed current (about 1.0 A) is far below that; a short or start-up on a loaded rail saturates it. Which listed current is Isat is not in the JLC text; no Bourns datasheet on file.
inductor.recommendation: do not order the SRR6040A as is. B if the board takes an 11x10 mm body, otherwise D; read each part's Isat first.

assembly.title: Choice 5: parts JLCPCB cannot assemble
rows: you buy and ship; JLC places
B. swap for a JLC-stocked part
e.g. U45 LT6232 C grade (JLC stock 2)
through-hole; QFN-64 and SSOP-16 are not hand work
assembly.consequence: Off JLC: U8 (stock 0), U21, U26-U28, U45 (JLC lists only the C grade), P1/P2/U15 and U30 as the C-grade 100T. CON2 (barrel jack), J2 header and six LEDs have no part number yet.
assembly.recommendation: A for U8, U21, U26-U28, U45 and the SMA connectors; C for CON2 and J2; choose the L5-L7 substitute before ordering.

library.title: Choice 6: is kicad/libs/fmcw3.lib still needed?
rows: a library edit; ideas stay in git
C. delete and drop sym-lib-table entry
library.consequence: It is the live symbol library (20 symbols are placed). The 76 unused retired ideas (AD7266, AD9269, MAX2870 and others) are drawn on by no choice here.
library.recommendation: B later (leave A for now); never C.

tgrade.title: Choice 7: clock buffer U6, PL133-37 temperature grade
tgrade.consequence: Datasheet p.5 Ordering Information lists both, SOT23-6, tape and reel. Same package, so the footprint is unchanged; the TI-R would have to be consigned.
tgrade.recommendation: A, the TC-R, because it is the one JLC stocks; the temperature grade is your choice.

lmr.title: Choice 8: buck U17-U19, LMR51420 variant
lmr.consequence: Datasheet p.3 comparison table; all four are SOT-23 6-pin DDC (p.26), so the package does not choose. The schematic states no frequency or mode. The 33 uH inductor (choice 4) goes with this choice.
lmr.recommendation: A, YF: fixed frequency at light load so no burst tones in the IF band, JLC stock {U17.jlc_stock} against {U17.need} needed.

y2.title: Choice 9: oscillator Y2, package and footprint mismatch
rows: {Y2.jlc_package} body; needs a 3.2x2.5 footprint: board change
its datasheet is for you to obtain
y2.consequence: The datasheet (p.1) is for a 3.2x2.5 mm package; the footprint is 2.5x2.0 mm (ECS 2520MV), so they do not match. 400 = 40.000 MHz, B = 1.0 ppm, N = -40 to 85 C, TR = reel.
y2.recommendation: B if its datasheet shows 40 MHz clipped sine, since A changes the layout.

balun.title: par-09 option: baluns U26-U28 (5400BL15B0050001E, not in JLC database)
rows: 0402 4-terminal against 0805 5-terminal: footprint change; amplitude +-2.5 dB against 2 dB: rf-01
balun.consequence: tdk-hhm1907b1-datasheet p2 (pins, land pattern) and p3 (4900-5950 MHz, IL 0.8 dB, phase 170-190 deg); johanson-5400bl15b0050001e-datasheet p1. No TDK S-parameter file is on file (user-fetch). Saves about 9 USD for 9 baluns and the consign lead time.
balun.recommendation: A, sourced or consigned: the saving is small and B needs a layout change plus rf-01.

opamp.title: par-09 option: op-amp U45 (LT6232IGN#PBF, JLC lists the C grade only)
rows: drop-in, 0 to 70 C; JLC stock covers 2 of 3 boards
footprint change (SSOP-16 to two SO-8), sim-02 re-run, C grade
opamp.consequence: adi-lt6232-datasheet p2 (operating range), p3-p4 (order table, electrical). The same die family sets the electrical data of C.
opamp.recommendation: A, sourced or consigned, to keep the -40 C range.

ldo.title: par-09 option: LDO U21 (LP2985A-10DBVR, the 10 V output)
rows: BYPASS pin 4 becomes an FB divider: layout change, noise check
ldo.consequence: ti-lp2985-datasheet p3 (pins) and p4 (1.2 to 10.0 V options); ti-tps7a24-datasheet p1, p3; microchip-mic5205-datasheet p1. The 10 V rail sets the loop-filter op-amp supply, so noise is compared in sim-01 and sim-spurs (not done).
ldo.recommendation: A, sourced or consigned; C or D only to save lead time, with the divider and the noise check.

sma.title: par-09 option: SMA connectors P1, P2, U15 (CONSMA003.062, not in JLC database)
rows: 0-6 GHz, 50 ohm, 0.15 dB at 6 GHz (batwireless-bwsma-ke-p001-datasheet p.4); drawing p.6: land pattern and board-thickness fit unverified
sma.consequence: B is JLC-stocked and rated to 6 GHz (batwireless-bwsma-ke-p001-datasheet p.4, drawing p.6); assume a footprint change until its drawing is compared with the CONSMA003.062 footprint. The Amphenol 132134-15 route was dropped: its datasheet could not be fetched (user-fetch row).
sma.recommendation: A, through the JLC sourcing service or consigned; B if you accept a footprint change after comparing its drawing (p.6) with the current footprint.

atten.title: par-09 option: attenuator U12 PAT1220 3 dB (JLC stock 5 for 3)
rows: same part; stock below twice the need
1.6x0.8 mm footprint change; power below 64 mW (datasheet p1): rf-01
atten.consequence: pat1220-attenuator-datasheet p1 (ratings, both parts: PAT0816 64 mW, PAT1220 100 mW) and p2 (sizes: 0603 and 0805).
atten.recommendation: A, ordered from JLC stock at once.

fb4.title: Choice 10: PA supply bead FB4, current margin
fb4.consequence: FB4 feeds the PA U14 from 5 V. The QPA9501 datasheet gives 650 mA max at 22 dBm and nothing at the 25.5 dBm target (par-07), so A's margin at full power has no datasheet number. Both rows from the Murata table (murata-blm18pg181sn1d-datasheet). B's impedance curve differs, so sim-01's 5 V branch has to use its model before B is final; recorded in docs/board-changes.md.
fb4.recommendation: B, for the current margin and lower DC drop, once sim-01 shows no new resonance on the 5 V branch.

rx1-fpga.title: 1-RX choice: FPGA U30 (JLC has the I grade only)
cols: JLC (C number, stock for the need, USD each)
rows: par-03 choice 1 pin check (same 256 balls); Table 12 lists -1C and -1I [amd-ds180-7series-overview p.15; amd-xc7a100t-ftg256-pinout]
rx1-fpga.consequence: JLC database 2026-11-22. The C grade has no JLC row; the I grade is the same die and 256 balls (par-03 choice 1 pin check), value C to I, so it is a drop-in.
rx1-fpga.recommendation: A, XC7A100T-1FTG256I: JLC stock 59 for 3; B costs more and has less stock.

rx1-balun.title: 1-RX choice: baluns U26, U27 (U28 is receive chain 2)
cols: JLC (C number, stock for the need, USD each)
rows: rf-01: amplitude balance +-2.5 dB against 2 dB, insertion loss 0.8 dB max, phase 170-190 deg (p.3); no TDK S-parameter file on file, so no simulation covers it [tdk-hhm1907b1-datasheet p.2; tdk-hhm1907b1-datasheet p.3; johanson-5400bl15b0050001e-datasheet p.1]
rx1-balun.consequence: The only JLC-stocked balun on file is the TDK HHM1907B1: 0402 four-terminal against the 0805 five-terminal part, so a footprint change. Amplitude balance 2.5 dB against 2 dB; no TDK S-parameter file is on file, so no simulation covers it (rf-01 uses the Johanson file).
rx1-balun.recommendation: A is the only JLC-stocked option; the RF effect is not simulated.

rx1-opamp.title: 1-RX choice: op-amp U45 (JLC lists the C grade only)
cols: JLC (C number, stock for the need, USD each)
rows: stock only: fails for 3 boards [adi-lt6232-datasheet p.3]
B. LT6231CS8#TRPBF (C grade, SO-8), one per board

step 3 simulation (sim/adc_input.json) already runs the LT6231 subcircuit (adi-lt6231-ltspice-bundled): its swing, common mode, settling and IF response apply unchanged; C grade is 0 to 70 C specified (p.3 order table) [adi-lt6232-datasheet p.2; adi-lt6232-datasheet p.3]
rx1-opamp.consequence: The 1-RX chain uses amps A and B only, so one LT6231 (dual, SO-8) replaces the quad. The step 3 LTspice run already uses the LT6231 subcircuit, so swing, common mode, settling and IF response apply unchanged. C grade is 0 to 70 C. The LT6232CGN has stock 2 for a need of 3. If A is chosen, U45 amps C and D need the rx1-unused-amps choice.
rx1-opamp.recommendation: B, LT6231CS8#TRPBF: JLC stock 54; footprint change SSOP-16 to SO-8; the unused pair and the /ADC_VCMA merge disappear.

rx1-ldo.title: 1-RX choice: LDO U21, 10 V output (LP2985A-10 not in JLC stock)
cols: JLC (C number, stock for the need, USD each)
rows: stock only: fails [ti-lp2985-datasheet p.3; ti-lp2985-datasheet p.4]

divider for 10 V (see ldo_check); dropout 250 mV max at 200 mA against 2 V headroom (p.6); noise 300 uVrms at 1.24 V (p.6) scales with the divider gain, against 30 uVrms for the LP2985 (p.1): not simulated, sim-01 / sim-spurs [ti-tps7a24-datasheet p.3; ti-tps7a24-datasheet p.6; ti-tps7a24-datasheet p.14; ti-lp2985-datasheet p.3]

divider for 10 V (see ldo_check); 12 V input is inside the 16 V maximum; noise 260 nV/rtHz (p.4); not simulated [microchip-mic5205-datasheet p.2; microchip-mic5205-datasheet p.9; microchip-mic5205-datasheet p.11]
rx1-ldo.consequence: Design change: pin 4 BYPASS becomes FB, two divider resistors; for 10 V, R994 1.15 M / R995 162 k gives 10.04 V (9.71 to 10.39 V worst case). Output noise is not covered by any simulation: 300 uVrms at 1.24 V scales to about 2.4 mVrms unfiltered, against 30 uVrms for the LP2985; the 10 V rail feeds U7 (sim-01, sim-spurs).
rx1-ldo.recommendation: B, TPS7A2401DBVR (stock 10425); C is the alternative; neither noise figure is simulated.

rx1-sma.title: 1-RX choice: SMA connectors P1, U15 (P2 is receive chain 2)
cols: JLC (C number, stock for the need, USD each)
rows: 0-6 GHz, 0.15 dB at 6 GHz (p.4) covers 5.6-5.9 GHz; mounting fit is a layout and enclosure decision; no simulation covers the pad transition [batwireless-bwsma-ke-p001-datasheet p.3; batwireless-bwsma-ke-p001-datasheet p.4; batwireless-bwsma-ke-p001-datasheet p.6; dk-consma003.062 p.1]
user fetches amphenol-132134-datasheet, then compare land pattern and board thickness (the board is 1.5266 mm) [no datasheet on file]
rx1-sma.consequence: A is a vertical, screw-on SMA (6.5 mm square body, through-board pin): a design change to the cable direction and board edge. B is an edge-mount SMD jack like today's, but its datasheet is not on file (docs/user-fetch.md row amphenol-132134-datasheet), so nothing is claimed about it.
rx1-sma.recommendation: none recommended: if you save the Amphenol datasheet, B is the like-for-like part; else A is the only option with a datasheet on file.

rx1-inductor.title: 1-RX choice: inductors L5-L7 (33 uH, LMR51420 current limit)
cols: JLC (C number, stock for the need, USD each)
rows: inductor_check: Isat 5.05 A above the 3.5 A typ and below the 5.1 A max high-side peak limit (p.5); p.18 asks for Isat above the peak limit; well above the 2 A full-load peak [coilank-aps1040m330a-datasheet p.8; ti-lmr51420-datasheet p.5; ti-lmr51420-datasheet p.18]
inductor_check: 3.3 A is below the 3.5 A typ limit but above the 2 A full-load peak; no datasheet on file, so the rating is a listing figure [ti-lmr51420-datasheet p.5; ti-lmr51420-datasheet p.18]
rx1-inductor.consequence: Only the APS1040M330A has Isat (5.05 A) near the LMR51420 high-side limit (3.5 A typ, 5.1 A max, ti-lmr51420-datasheet p.5; p.18: Isat above the limit). SMS0650 and FCH0650 clear the 2 A full-load peak only and their ratings are listing figures. The par-09 options saturate near 1 A.
rx1-inductor.recommendation: A, APS1040M330A (11.5 x 10 mm footprint change, board room to check).

rx1-atten.title: 1-RX choice: attenuators U3 and U12 (PAT1220, no MPN in the schematic)
cols: JLC (C number, stock for the need, USD each)
rows: rf-01 level plan; no simulation yet [pat1220-attenuator-datasheet p.1; pat1220-attenuator-datasheet p.2]
rf-01 level plan: power at U12 must stay below 64 mW (18 dBm); not run [pat1220-attenuator-datasheet p.1; pat1220-attenuator-datasheet p.2]
rx1-atten.consequence: Same Susumu PAT1220 0805 part; the maker's table says DC to 10 GHz where the JLC text says 0-3 GHz. U12 has JLC stock 5 for a need of 3: order at once. PAT0816 is a 0603 footprint change at 64 mW.

rx1-led.title: 1-RX choice: LEDs D1-D3, D5-D7 (colour)
cols: JLC (C number, stock for the need, USD each)
rx1-led.consequence: Red is a drop-in; white, green and blue (Vf up to 3.1 V) need the series resistors re-sized.
rx1-led.recommendation: A, red; the colour is yours.

rx1-conn.title: 1-RX choice: barrel jack CON2 and header J2 (through-hole)
cols: JLC (C number, stock for the need, USD each)
rows: compare the PCB layout on p.1 with the BarrelJack footprint; whether JLC places through-hole parts is for the user to confirm in the order tool [xunpu-dc-005-a200-datasheet p.1]
the 0.04 mm per row mismatch (0.28 mm over 8 rows) means a new footprint at 2.54 mm [boomele-2-54-2x8-header-datasheet p.1]
rx1-conn.consequence: Both are footprint changes (J2: 2.54 mm part on 2.5 mm pads). Whether JLC places through-hole parts for this order is for you to confirm in the order tool.

rx1-mixer.title: 1-RX choice: mixer U29 (JLC stock equals the need)
cols: JLC (C number, stock for the need, USD each)
rows: A. ADL5802ACPZ-R7 (as is, order at once)
stock only; the stock must be re-read on the day of the order [adi-adl5802-datasheet p.30]
needs the ADL5801 datasheet and rf-01; not evaluated [no datasheet on file]
rx1-mixer.consequence: Stock 3 for a need of 3 passes with no spare; the stock must be re-read on the day of the order. The ADL5801 is a single mixer but its datasheet is not in the manifest, so nothing is claimed.

rx1-mode.title: 1-RX choice: MODE strap R92 (10k or 11k)
rows: within 2 percent of the 2/3 AVDD row; the datasheet gives nominal levels only
rx1-mode.consequence: adi-ad9237-datasheet p.21 (Table 10: 2/3 AVDD is twos complement, DCS on) and p.10 (Figure 5, 70 kohm pull-down). The firmware reads signed twos complement (adc.vhd).
rx1-mode.recommendation: A: no thresholds are given, so a 2 percent offset needs no part change.

rx1-unused-amps.title: 1-RX choice: unused U45 amps C and D (only if U45 stays the SSOP-16 quad)
rows: R31, R38, R63, R64 not fitted; R39, R40, C39, C40 kept
each unused amp is a unity follower on the bias, no floating node
B. also not fit R39, R40
C. tie the + inputs to GND
outside the input range at 3.3 V
rx1-unused-amps.consequence: adi-lt6232-datasheet p.3 (input common-mode range 1.15 to 2.65 V at 3.3 V). Not needed when rx1-opamp is B.

rx1-ifbias.title: 1-RX choice: R51, R52 (IF1 pull-ups of the shared mixer)
rows: the ADL5802 IF1 open-collector output keeps its pull-up
your call; no check covers the unused IF1 output
rx1-ifbias.consequence: adi-adl5802-datasheet p.6 (Table 3: OP1+/- need a pull-up). They are receive-chain-2 only electrically but bias the shared part.
rx1-ifbias.recommendation: A: leaves the shared mixer exactly as in 2-RX.
